name: Satan Ruling The Airwaves
overview: Scripture reveals that Satan is described as the 'prince of the power of the air,' actively influencing the disobedient and stirring the hearts of men toward rebellion and falsehood (Ephesians 2:2; Psalms 2:1). He is characterized as the father of lies and a murderer from the beginning, opposing truth at every turn (John 8:44). Yet, believers are encouraged to approach God's throne boldly to receive grace and help in times of temptation, trusting in Christ who understands and succors those who are tempted (Hebrews 4:16; Hebrews 2:18). Ultimately, nothing hidden remains secret, for all will be revealed, underscoring the certainty of God's justice over Satan's schemes (Luke 8:17).
